authentication: Existing CONNECT gate and report identity/ownership checks, no extra permission

parameters.download: 1 for raw complete attachment; any other supplied value rejected (422)

success.body: Exact stored payload_json bytes, no re-encoding

errors.404: missing report or other owner without existing global read permission
errors.503: stored payload not a report object with observations array

unconfirmed.message: Keep draft; verify stored copy before retry

import.required: Report object with observations array, or API envelope report.payload
import.independence: Remove onlineReportId only; preserve internal business ids and references
import.structureMarker: copie_test === true; strict historical test copy also detected
import.editingLimit: Unsafe JavaScript integers rejected before editing; raw download remains exact
